QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Sweetiepie Giftstravaganza
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra seems really excited about something... or desperate. It's hard to tell with her.
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the Rosey Marble you got from Cassandra for 1 hour to turn it into a Heartshaker Marble. #bRemember: the marble will disappear if you log out before then!
QuestInfo.2: Hold on to Cassandra's marbles once each day to receive a Sweetiepie Gift Box!
